A rigorous technical research evaluation illuminating the convergence of artificial intelligence with robotic process automation to achieve end-to-end enterprise cognitive workflows.

Key Highlights:
• Comparative analysis of traditional rule-based RPA vs. cognitive IPA
• Architectural patterns for human-in-the-loop exception handling
• Cost-benefit metrics and ROI projection models for enterprise adoption
• Security, governance, and bot credential management standards

Tech Stack: Technical Research, IPA Frameworks, UiPath / BluePrism Analysis
Repository: https://github.com/hrlpavan/IPA-AND-RPA-REPORT

title: AutoSubs For DaVinci Resolve
description:
An essential workflow productivity tool for video creators that extracts timeline audio, runs automated speech recognition, and builds animated subtitles natively inside DaVinci Resolve.

Key Highlights:
• Direct DaVinci Resolve timeline audio track extraction
• Local Whisper model inference with zero external cloud cost
• Automated word-by-word subtitle track generation directly into timeline
• Custom text styling and animation preset injection

Tech Stack: Python, DaVinci Resolve Scripting API, OpenAI Whisper, FFmpeg
Repository: https://github.com/hrlpavan/AutoSubs-For-Resolve

title: Databricks Project & Milestone Pipeline
description:
A structured academic and industrial milestone pipeline showcasing structured data engineering, feature extraction, and predictive modeling on Databricks clusters.

Key Highlights:
• Step-by-step milestone notebooks covering data ingestion, cleaning, and aggregation
• Integration of machine learning algorithms on distributed datasets
• Automated quality assertions and missing value imputations
• Visual analytics and business KPI dashboards

Tech Stack: Jupyter Notebook, Databricks Runtime, PySpark MLlib, Matplotlib
Repository: https://github.com/hrlpavan/Project-And-MileStone-Databricks
